messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: KV cache eviction rate spiked on cluster yarn-us-west-2; continuous_batch queue depth > 95% for 10m; lat p50->p99 increased. Pager -> @maria (oncall) :rotating_light: 

maria (oncall): seeing it. spike aligns with a large rope long-context rollout (NTK=4096 + sliding-window). logs show repeated cache misses and prefetch storms.

alex (runtime): jumping in. initial hypothesis: sliding-window prefetch + continuous batching created overlapping prefix cache writes -> KV cardinality explosion.

jordan (sre): any customer-facing impact yet? dashboards show error rate stable but lat tail up, queued requests piling up on dedicated pools.

maria (oncall): customer-ops notified. @chris which tenants are hitting the long-context path?

chris (customer-ops): two enterprise tenants (corp-a, corp-b) on dedicated capacity reported elevated API latencies, some timeouts in their retry logs. They're seeing 502s intermittently.

sam (product): are these tenants on the new rope scaling config (auto-extend ntk/yaRN)? We flagged that for gradual rollout.

alex (runtime): yes, ramp target was 20% of traffic. looks like the rollout triggered some large prefix sequences that amplified kv cardinality. continuous_batch config used: {
  "batch_window_ms": 50,
  "max_batch_tokens": 2048,
  "enable_continuous_batch": true,
  "prefetch_strategy": "sliding_window_v2"
}

alex (runtime): quick mitigation options in order: 1) disable continuous_batch for affected pool, 2) reduce batch_window_ms to 10, 3) revert sliding_window prefetch to conservative mode, 4) scale pool out (slow).

maria (oncall): priority is to restore customer p99. I'm going to disable continuous_batch on yarn-us-west-2 pool and set prefetch to conservative. will post commands.

deploy-bot: Runbook trigger: "Disable continuous batch" executed by maria (oncall) at 2255011283.

maria (oncall): command run:
```
redwoodctl pool update --region yarn-us-west-2 --pool-id yarn-dedicated-3 --set enable_continuous_batch=false --set prefetch_strategy=sliding_window_conservative
```

maria (oncall): applying now, rolling config across nodes (10 nodes). watching KV eviction metric and queue depth.

alex (runtime): also pushing a targeted hotfix to drop the max_batch_tokens to 1024 for that pool:
```
redwoodctl pool update --region yarn-us-west-2 --pool-id yarn-dedicated-3 --set max_batch_tokens=1024
```

jordan (sre): after disable: observed queue depth dropping within 40s, p99 reduced from 3.1s -> 1.2s in the affected pool. KV eviction rate trending down. no errors introduced.

chris (customer-ops): corp-a confirms reduced tail latency, corp-b still seeing occasional spikes but much better. they're asking for a short summary and ETA for a durable fix.

sam (product): can we capture which prompt shapes caused the worst hits? need replay for regression test.

alex (runtime): logging shows long prefix reuse patterns from multi-turn sessions (user agents that hold 3k tokens context, NTK extension path). We'll extract a strawman prompt set.

maria (oncall): paging handoff: handing to alex for follow-up investigations. I'll stay on for 10 more minutes for stabilization then hand to @jordan for oncall.

maria (oncall): Handoff notes: disabled continuous_batch on yarn-us-west-2 pool, reduced max_batch_tokens to 1024, prefetch_strategy -> sliding_window_conservative. watchlist: kv_eviction_rate, continuous_batch_queue_depth, model_inference_errors.

alex (runtime): ack. I'll run analysis and produce a short postmortem with root cause and two actionable mitigations: 1) throttle prefetch cardinality when NTK>2048, 2) add adaptive batch_window based on cache pressure.

jordan (sre): I'll take over the oncall rotation. will monitor for next 3 hours and coordinate any customer escalations.

chris (customer-ops): sending interim customer note: "We're mitigating a performance regression caused by a long-context rollout and batch-prefetch interaction. We've applied a targeted mitigation that has reduced tail latency significantly. We'll follow up with a detailed update and ETA for a permanent fix."

sam (product): flagging this for rollback consideration on the remainder of the rollout until we have the prefetched-cardinality guard.

alex (runtime): further notes for post-incident: instrument per-tenant prefix-cardinality, add alarm for per-pool prefetch write rate > X, and add an auto-disable for continuous_batch when eviction>Y.

maria (oncall): logging final: p99 back to 1.1s cluster-wide for affected pool, customers notified. closing pager. if anything regresses re-pager me. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: Severity reduced to P2 at 2255011642 — runbook: "yarn-prefetch-overspill".

jordan (sre): I'll collect logs for the postmortem and scrub PII, then schedule a 30min review with runtime + product tomorrow.

sam (product): thanks team. action items: alex (root cause analysis + replay harness), jordan (postmortem + timeline), sam (customer follow-up draft).

maria (oncall): good job all. :thumbsup:
